categories.main_business_segments: Qinhuangdao Tianqin Equipment Manufacturing Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the defense equipment protection sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of specialized protective devices and equipment components made from polymer composites and metal materials. The company also engages in technical services and other related businesses. Its products serve multiple defense branches including army, navy, air force, and rocket forces, and extend to civilian protective packaging applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as polymer composite material modification, finite element analysis, mold flow analysis, injection molding, blow molding, hand lay-up, and resin infusion techniques. It has developed proprietary high-performance engineering plastics and resin-based composite materials with superior impact resistance, thermal stability, and mechanical strength. The manufacturing process includes automated injection molding with robotic arms and extrusion granulation for raw material production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major defense equipment manufacturers and final users within the Chinese military, notably subsidiaries of China North Industries Group Corporation (China Ordnance Group) and China Ordnance Equipment Group. The company also serves defense export markets and civilian sectors requiring specialized protective packaging. Its products are integral to ammunition storage, transport, and protection for various calibers and new weapon systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant sales distributed across Northeast, Northwest, North China, Southwest, East China, South China, and Central China regions. It has limited overseas sales. Its headquarters and manufacturing facilities are located in Qinhuangdao City, Hebei Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qinhuangdao Tianqin Equipment Manufacturing Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream segment of the defense supply chain, specializing in the production of critical protective components and packaging for defense equipment and ammunition. It supplies parts and assemblies to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and integrates into the broader defense manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes strategic and forward-looking R&D investments focused on developing new materials, intelligent and information-based protective devices, and integrated storage-transport-launch systems. It emphasizes innovation in high-performance polymer composites, metal protective devices, and specialized ammunition components. The company also fosters industry-academia collaboration to enhance its technological capabilities and expand product lines into new defense and civilian applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of proprietary specialized protective devices and equipment components to defense OEMs and final users. The company also earns income from technical development contracts and customized production for civilian clients. Sales are predominantly direct, supported by long-term contracts and close collaboration with military and defense industry customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as one of the leading domestic suppliers in the defense equipment protection sector, recognized for its technological expertise and product quality. It competes with other specialized defense component manufacturers, including state-owned and private enterprises within the Chinese defense industrial base. It holds national-level certifications and has been awarded for technological innovation, reinforcing its competitive standing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 154.58 million, a 4.51% increase from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 32.19 million, up 19.70%. Total assets reached about RMB 965.3 million, with steady growth in net assets. The company maintains positive cash flow from operations and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, indicating a stable growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its proprietary high-performance engineering plastics and composite materials that offer superior impact resistance, thermal stability, and environmental adaptability for defense applications. Its products meet stringent military standards for reliability and durability under extreme conditions. The company’s integrated design and manufacturing capabilities, combined with strong customer relationships and industry certifications, provide a comprehensive and trusted protective solution for modern defense equipment.
